pages: Already logged. You can keep your hands free.
Thanks. Pump seals. Maybe the floor gets to stay dry tonight.

pages: It will not roll. A red wheel clamp is still fastened around the near wheel.
A release handle sits just beside it.
The wheels roll freely. You push the trolley west into LOADING BAY 2.
LOADING POSITION CONFIRMED. You can check out at the gate.
You pull the handle. The clamp opens and its indicator turns green.

waiting.speaker: MARA
pages: Blue parcel for me? It comes from dispatch, in the shed. Use “give Mara the blue parcel” when you have it.
He makes every shift sound like a national emergency.

case.speaker: MARA
pages: The empty case goes back to CASE RETURNS, in the shed to the east. Thank you.

coffee.speaker: MARA
pages: You got the case back. That is one less thing for the next shift.
The coffee machine upstairs in the staff room doesn't work again. Nobody has the time to look at it. Certainly not me.

thanks.speaker: MARA
pages: Coffee that works. I could get used to this shift.
Same train home? Get some sleep when you can.

Pick up the blue parcel at dispatch, just to my left. Bring it to Mara at receiving, back west in the yard.
